name: schema-migration-meta-convention
claim: Removal or renaming of a field from the assertion schema happens via DAG-authorized schema migration. A migration consists of: (a) a compound belief asserting the migrations decision, with deps citing both this meta-convention and the primitive(s) carrying the new schema rules — the compound is the audit anchor and the citation point for future references, while the primitives carry the schema content; (b) adjudication through the consensus mechanism (once built) or direct user authorization (interim); (c) a bulk transformation executed under the compounds authority; (d) supersession or retirement of any contract the migration conflicts with. b029s per-node immutability permits this class of operation and no other. Individual node fields remain immutable outside authorized migrations.

evidence.detail: Supersedes an earlier version. Step (a) is revised from a primitive asserting the decision to a compound asserting it via deps, because primitives cannot carry deps, so a primitive-only migration cannot cite the meta-convention that authorized it. A compound at step (a) restores the citation path, with the schema-rule primitives as its deps.
